title: Slovakian Pork Dumplings with Pickled Onions
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring tender pork dumplings in a flavorful broth, topped with crispy pickled onions and vibrant fresh parsley.
instructions: Heat the shortening in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced pork shoulder and sear until browned, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sour cream, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the seared pork and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape into balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of water in the center of each circle and fold the dough to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Bring the water to a boil in a large pot and cook the dumplings for 10-15 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Garnish with pickled onions and fresh parsley.
